title: Realization-discipline audit record
description: The codomain of auditing-the-realization-discipline-of-a-script — a static-analysis record comparing a script's source bytes against the discipline the script's record declares. Pure-function-on-json conformance is mechanical (the (R1)–(R4) corollary of the transformer theorem); the other disciplines yield a best-effort feature inventory without mechanical pass/fail.

script-path.description: The has-path of the audited script.

declared-discipline.description: The has-realization-discipline cell read off the script record.

observations.description: Static-analysis feature flags found in the script's source after comment-stripping. Each flag is a syntactic signature of a side-effect class. The flags are observations regardless of declared discipline; the discipline determines which of them count as violations.

conforms.description: True iff violations is empty. For pure-function-on-json this is mechanically decided; for other disciplines no rules currently produce violations, so conforms is true vacuously.

violations.description: Human-readable strings naming each violation of the declared discipline.
